articles.title_en: Cognitive and socioemotional skills in low-income countries: Measurement and associations with schooling and earnings
articles.title_cn: 低收入国家的认知与社会情感技能：测量及其与学校教育和收入的关联
articles.abstract_en: We assess the reliability and validity of cognitive and socioemotional skills measures and investigate the correlation between schooling, skills acquisition, and labor earnings. Our primary data from Pakistan incorporate two innovations related to measurement and sampling. With regard to measurement, we developed and implemented a battery of instruments intended to capture cognitive and socioemotional skills among young adults. With regard to sampling, we use a panel that follows respondents from their original rural locations in 2003 to their residences in 2018, a period over which 38% of respondents left their native villages. We first show that in terms of their validity and reliability, our skills measures compare favorably to previous measurement attempts in low- and middle-income countries. We then document that in our data (a) more years of schooling are correlated with higher cognitive and socioemotional skills, (b) labor earnings are correlated with cognitive and socioemotional skills, conditional on years of schooling, and (c) the earnings-skills correlations depend on respondents’ migration status. The magnitude of the correlations between schooling and skills on the one hand and earnings and skills on the other is consistent with a widespread concern that such skills are underproduced in the schooling system.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们评估了认知和社会情感技能测量的信度与效度，并研究了学校教育、技能获取与劳动收入之间的相关性。我们在巴基斯坦的主要数据包含两项与测量和抽样相关的创新。在测量方面，我们开发并实施了一套旨在捕捉年轻成人认知和社会情感技能的工具。在抽样方面，我们使用了一个面板数据，追踪受访者从2003年的原始农村居住地到2018年的居住地，在此期间38%的受访者离开了他们的原籍村庄。我们首先表明，在效度和信度方面，我们的技能测量与以往在中低收入国家的测量尝试相比表现良好。然后我们记录到，在我们的数据中，(a) 更多的学校教育年限与更高的认知和社会情感技能相关，(b) 在控制学校教育年限后，劳动收入与认知和社会情感技能相关，以及 (c) 收入与技能之间的相关性取决于受访者的迁移状态。学校教育与技能之间以及收入与技能之间的相关性大小与一种普遍担忧一致，即此类技能在学校教育体系中生产不足。

articles.title_en: Employment effects of minimum wages in a dual economy: Evidence from Thailand
articles.title_cn: 二元经济中最低工资的就业效应：来自泰国的证据
articles.abstract_en: This study employs both theoretical insights and empirical techniques to investigate the impact of a minimum wage increase on employment when minimum wage coverage is incomplete. Previous empirical studies on this topic have found conflicting results: while some find the share of the covered sector decreases, some find it increases. In the theoretical part, we extended the classic two-sector model and found both scenarios can occur depending on the parameters of the economy. Empirically, using as a natural experiment a novel minimum wage policy in Thailand whereby 40 percent of workers were not covered by the legislation, we found that one percent increase in the minimum wage reduced low-skilled employment in the covered sector by 0.1–1.1 percent and increased employment in the uncovered sector. The official unemployment rate also decreased because the rise in the minimum wage lowered the probability of covered employment to such a large extent that workers instead turned to the uncovered sector.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究结合理论见解与实证技术，探讨最低工资覆盖不完全时最低工资上调对就业的影响。以往关于此主题的实证研究结果相互矛盾：一些研究发现受覆盖部门份额下降，另一些则发现其上升。在理论部分，我们扩展了经典的两部门模型，发现两种情形都可能发生，取决于经济参数。实证上，利用泰国一项新颖的最低工资政策作为自然实验，其中40%的工人不受该立法覆盖，我们发现最低工资每增加百分之一，受覆盖部门低技能就业减少0.1-1.1%，而未受覆盖部门就业增加。官方失业率也下降，因为最低工资上升大幅降低了受覆盖就业的概率，以至于工人转而进入未受覆盖部门。

articles.abstract_en: The trade route between Manila and Mexico was a monopoly of the Spanish Crown for more than 250 years. The ships that sailed this route — the Manila Galleons, were “the richest ships in all the oceans”, but much of the wealth sank at sea and remains undiscovered. We introduce a newly constructed dataset of all of the ships that traveled this route, and construct a model showing how monopoly rents that allowed widespread bribery would have led to inefficient cargo loading and delayed ship departure, which increased the probability of shipwreck beyond normal levels. Empirically, we demonstrate not only that ships that sailed late were more likely to shipwreck, but also that the effect is stronger for galleons carrying more valuable, higher-rent, cargo. This sheds new light on the relationship between, and social costs from, monopoly rents and corruption.
articles.abstract_cn: 马尼拉与墨西哥之间的贸易航线被西班牙王室垄断了超过250年。航行于这条航线的船只——马尼拉大帆船，被誉为“所有海洋中最富有的船只”，但其中大量财富沉入海底，至今未被发现。我们引入了一个新构建的数据集，涵盖所有航行于该航线的船只，并构建了一个模型，展示垄断租金如何导致广泛的贿赂，进而引发低效的货物装载和船只出发延误，从而将沉船概率提升至正常水平之上。实证上，我们不仅证明了晚出发的船只更易沉没，而且这一效应在运载更有价值、租金更高货物的帆船中更为显著。这为垄断租金与腐败之间的关系及其社会成本提供了新的视角。

articles.title_en: Persistent effects of colonial land tenure institutions: Village-level evidence from India
articles.title_cn: 殖民土地制度安排的持久影响：来自印度的村级证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper estimates the causal impact of land revenue institutions on long run rural development using a Spatial Regression Discontinuity framework on a new village level data set from colonial India. An early 19th century historical quirk meant that villages in close geographical proximity were assigned to different property rights systems — some falling under landlords and others under the government. Villages that were assigned to landlords in the colonial era have a higher poverty rate and lower consumption per capita in 2012. Village census data from 1961 to 2011 shows that historically rooted characteristics in landlord villages prevented them from accessing Green Revolution technologies. Analysis demonstrates that non-landlord, cultivator villages secured preferential access to public investment in the early decades. Despite some convergence in public goods availability, lower private wealth and investment in landlord villages causes continuing spatial inequalities.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用殖民时期印度新的村级数据集，通过空间断点回归框架，估计土地税收制度对长期农村发展的因果影响。19世纪早期的一个历史巧合意味着，地理位置相近的村庄被分配到了不同的产权制度下——有些归地主所有，有些则归政府所有。在殖民时期被分配给地主的村庄在2012年的贫困率更高，人均消费更低。从1961年到2011年的村庄普查数据显示，地主村庄中根深蒂固的历史特征阻碍了它们获取绿色革命技术。分析表明，非地主、耕种者村庄在早期几十年中获得了公共投资的优先获取权。尽管公共物品的可获得性有所趋同，但地主村庄较低的私人财富和投资导致了持续的空间不平等。

articles.title_cn: 机器人 与 出口 质量
articles.abstract_en: Robots are becoming a key part of manufacturing in developed and emerging economies. This paper examines how automation can affect international trade through quality upgrading. The effects of robot use on export quality are estimated, by combining cross-country and cross-industry data on industrial robots with detailed Harmonized System 10-digit trade data. Robot diffusion in (preexisting) foreign customers is used as an instrumental variable to predict robot adoption in the home country-industry. The findings show that robot diffusion increases the quality of exported products. Quality improvements are predominantly driven by upgrading of (initially) lower-quality exports of developed and developing countries. Since developing countries tend to export lower quality goods, we find stronger effects overall for developing economies. The paper also finds some differences in the type of robots – sophisticated or more basic – are associated with quality gains in developing and developed economies.
articles.abstract_cn: 机器人正成为发达经济体和新兴经济体制造业的关键组成部分。本文考察了自动化如何通过质量升级影响国际贸易。通过将工业机器人的跨国跨行业数据与详细的协调制度（HS）10位贸易数据相结合，估计了机器人使用对出口质量的影响。利用（先前存在的）外国客户中的机器人扩散作为工具变量，来预测本国行业内的机器人采用。研究结果表明，机器人扩散提高了出口产品的质量。质量提升主要由发达和发展中国家（初始）较低质量出口的升级所驱动。由于发展中国家倾向于出口较低质量的商品，我们发现总体上对发展中经济体的影响更强。本文还发现，不同类型的机器人——复杂或更基础的——与发达和发展中经济体的质量提升存在一些差异。

articles.title_en: Gains from market integration: Welfare effects of new rural roads in Ethiopia
articles.title_cn: 市场一体化的收益：埃塞俄比亚新建农村公路的福利效应
articles.abstract_en: This paper estimates the welfare gains from the construction of rural roads that connect agricultural villages to market centers. I take theoretical predictions from Ricardian trade models to a rich high spatial resolution micro data on agricultural production from Ethiopia, which coincides with a period of extensive rural road construction. I estimate that the road construction resulted in an approximately 13% increase in real agricultural income, on average, and show that this increase is attributed to the mechanisms suggested in the Ricardian trade model: the prices of villages’ comparative advantage crops increased, and villages reallocated land for these crops following decreases in trade costs.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文估算了连接农业村庄与市场中心的农村公路建设所带来的福利收益。我将李嘉图贸易模型的理论预测应用于埃塞俄比亚高空间分辨率的农业生产微观数据，这一时期恰逢大规模农村公路建设。我估计公路建设使实际农业收入平均增加了约13%，并表明这一增长归因于李嘉图贸易模型所提出的机制：村庄比较优势作物的价格上涨，且随着贸易成本下降，村庄将土地重新配置给这些作物。

articles.title_en: Driving while hungry: The effect of fasting on traffic accidents
articles.title_cn: 饥饿驾驶：斋戒对交通事故的影响
articles.abstract_en: I study the impact of hunger on traffic accidents by exploiting the fasting that is religiously mandated during the month of Ramadan. Identification comes from working hours not being adjusted during Ramadan in Turkey. I find that driving while fasting at rush hour is associated with a significant increase in road traffic accidents. Using existing survey evidence on fasting rates in Turkey, I conclude that hunger induced by fasting increases the probability of an accident by 25%, which is smaller than the effect of driving while intoxicated, but larger than the effect of mild sleep deprivation.
articles.abstract_cn: 我利用斋月期间宗教规定的斋戒来研究饥饿对交通事故的影响。识别策略来自土耳其斋月期间工作时间未调整这一事实。我发现，在高峰时段斋戒驾驶与道路交通事故显著增加相关。利用土耳其现有的斋戒率调查证据，我得出结论，斋戒引起的饥饿使事故概率增加了25%，这一影响小于醉酒驾驶的影响，但大于轻度睡眠剥夺的影响。

articles.title_en: Time for tea: Measuring discounting for money and consumption without the utility confound
articles.title_cn: 喝茶时间：在不混淆效用的情况下测量货币和消费的贴现率
articles.abstract_en: We present a novel method—called risk equivalents—that uses a single measure to elicit discount rates while avoiding concerns about the shape of the utility function. The method is valid under discounted expected utility (DEU), and also under several of its behavioral extensions including more general models that account for a biased perception of time and risk (such as time- or likelihood-insensitivity). We implement the method in a field experiment in India measuring inter-temporal discount rates for money and the consumption of tea. We empirically observe that discount rates elicited by traditional methods are related to utility curvature, whereas discount rates elicited by risk equivalents are not. Risk equivalents also mitigate differences in discount rates measured for money and for tea, suggesting that unaddressed utility curvature may play a role in results that demonstrate good-specific discounting. Risk equivalents are general, fast and tractable, three features that are particularly useful in field studies.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种新颖的方法——称为风险等价法——它使用单一度量来引出贴现率，同时避免了对效用函数形状的担忧。该方法在贴现期望效用（DEU）下有效，并且在其若干行为扩展下也有效，包括考虑时间和风险感知偏差的更一般模型（如时间或似然不敏感性）。我们在印度的一项实地实验中实施了该方法，测量了货币和茶消费的跨期贴现率。我们实证观察到，传统方法引出的贴现率与效用曲率相关，而风险等价法引出的贴现率则不然。风险等价法还减轻了货币和茶测量贴现率之间的差异，表明未处理的效用曲率可能在显示特定商品贴现的结果中起作用。风险等价法具有通用性、快速性和易处理性，这三个特点在实地研究中尤为有用。

articles.title_en: Gender violence, enforcement, and human capital: Evidence from women’s justice centers in Peru
articles.title_cn: 性别暴力、执法与人力资本：来自秘鲁妇女司法中心的证据
articles.abstract_en: In many developing countries, access to justice remains unequal, especially for women. What are the implications of this inequality for gender-based violence and investments in children? This paper provides evidence from Peru’s women’s justice centers (WJCs), which are specialized institutions that provide police, medical and legal services to reduce gender-based violence. Examining the gradual rollout of WJCs across districts and villages, we find that the opening of a center reduces the incidence of gender-based violence, as measured by self-reported domestic violence, female deaths due to aggression, and hospitalizations due to mental health, by about 10%. This decrease in women’s exposure to violence has intergenerational effects: WJCs substantially increase human capital investments in children, raising school attendance and test scores. The evidence suggests that these results are driven by an increase in enforcement against gender violence. After a WJC opens, there is an increase in the reporting and prosecutions for gender-specific crimes.
articles.abstract_cn: 在许多发展中国家，诉诸司法的机会仍然不平等，尤其是对女性而言。这种不平等对基于性别的暴力和对儿童的投资有何影响？本文提供了来自秘鲁妇女司法中心（WJCs）的证据，这些中心是提供警察、医疗和法律服务以减少基于性别暴力的专门机构。通过考察WJCs在各地区和村庄的逐步推广，我们发现中心的开设降低了基于性别暴力的发生率，以自我报告的 domestic violence、因攻击导致的女性死亡以及因心理健康问题导致的住院来衡量，降低了约10%。女性遭受暴力风险的降低具有代际效应：WJCs显著增加了对儿童的人力资本投资，提高了入学率和考试成绩。证据表明，这些结果是由对性别暴力的执法加强所驱动的。在WJC开设后，针对性别特定犯罪的报告和起诉有所增加。

articles.title_en: A mother’s voice: Impacts of spousal communication training on child health investments
articles.title_cn: 母亲的声音：配偶沟通培训对儿童健康投资的影响
articles.abstract_en: This study evaluates a communication training program for mothers in Uganda, motivated by prior evidence suggesting that mothers often prioritize children’s needs more than fathers. The program aims to enable women to effectively communicate their knowledge and preferences about child health to their husbands, thereby increasing investments in children’s health. Using a randomized experiment, we find that the program increases spousal discussion about the family’s health, nutrition, and finances. It also increases women’s and children’s intake of animal-sourced foods, as well as household spending on these foods. We find that birthweight of newborns increases. However, the program did not increase households’ adoption of measured health-promoting behaviors or improve other child anthropometric measures.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究评估了乌干达针对母亲的一项沟通培训项目，其动机源于先前证据表明母亲往往比父亲更优先考虑儿童的需求。该项目旨在使女性能够有效地向丈夫传达她们关于儿童健康的知识和偏好，从而增加对儿童健康的投资。通过随机实验，我们发现该项目增加了夫妻间关于家庭健康、营养和财务的讨论。它还增加了女性和儿童对动物源性食品的摄入，以及家庭在这些食品上的支出。我们发现新生儿的出生体重有所增加。然而，该项目并未增加家庭采取所测量的促进健康行为，也未改善其他儿童人体测量指标。

articles.title_en: Whom to ask? Testing respondent effects in household surveys
articles.title_cn: 询问谁？检验住户调查中的受访者效应
articles.abstract_en: Household questionnaires typically survey the most knowledgeable household member, but this can lead to inaccurate data if they have limited information. Using data from survey experiments with 4,100 households in Paraguay and Uganda, we investigate whether there are discrepancies in intra-household reporting when multiple household members are interviewed. We randomly vary who responds to a survey on household income and food consumption using common approaches to respondent selection. We find that the mean and distribution of these variables is insensitive to respondent selection. However, there are discrepancies between spouses of the same household in Uganda that depend on the gender of the respondent or recipient of the income. Taken together, our results indicate that respondent selection does not markedly affect the aggregate analysis of households, but that it may matter for obtaining accurate information on income and consumption for a given household or by gender.
articles.abstract_cn: 住户问卷通常调查最了解情况的家庭成员，但如果他们信息有限，这可能导致数据不准确。利用在巴拉圭和乌干达对4,100户家庭进行的调查实验数据，我们研究了当多个家庭成员接受采访时，住户内部报告是否存在差异。我们使用常见的受访者选择方法，随机变化谁回答关于家庭收入和食品消费的调查。我们发现这些变量的均值和分布对受访者选择不敏感。然而，在乌干达，同一家庭配偶之间的报告存在差异，这取决于受访者或收入接收者的性别。综合来看，我们的结果表明，受访者选择不会显著影响住户的总体分析，但对于获取特定住户或按性别划分的收入和消费准确信息可能很重要。

articles.title_en: Keeping refugee children in school and out of work: Evidence from the world's largest humanitarian cash transfer program
articles.title_cn: 让难民儿童留在学校而非工作：来自世界最大人道主义现金转移项目的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates whether unconditional cash transfers can keep refugee children in school and out of work. We raise this question in the unique context of Turkey, which hosts the world's largest refugee population (including 3.6 million Syrians). Refugees in Turkey are supported by the world's largest cash transfer program for refugees, the Emergency Social Safety Net (ESSN). We exploit a program eligibility criterion to identify the causal impacts of the ESSN program using a regression discontinuity design. The results show a large effect on child labor and school enrollment among both male and female refugee children. Being a beneficiary household reduces the fraction of children working from 14.0% to 1.6% (a decrease of 88%) and the fraction of children aged 6–17 not in school from 36.2 to 13.7% (a reduction of 62%). By unpacking the mechanisms at play, we show that ESSN cash transfers become a significant part of a household's income, substantially alleviate extreme poverty, and reduce a family's need to resort to harmful coping strategies. Investigating the reasons for children not attending school, we find that the beneficiary households become more likely to send children to school because the cash transfer addresses both the opportunity cost and direct cost of schooling—although the former channel is more important. The findings have important implications for the design of policies aimed at supporting refugee children at scale.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究无条件现金转移能否让难民儿童留在学校而非工作。我们在土耳其这一独特背景下提出这一问题，该国收容了世界上最大的难民人口（包括3.6万叙利亚人）。土耳其的难民得到了世界上最大的难民现金转移项目——紧急社会安全网（ESSN）的支持。我们利用项目资格标准，通过断点回归设计识别ESSN项目的因果影响。结果显示，该项目对男性和女性难民儿童的童工和入学率均有显著影响。成为受益家庭使儿童工作的比例从14.0%降至1.6%（下降88%），6-17岁儿童失学比例从36.2降至13.7%（减少62%）。通过解析其中的机制，我们表明ESSN现金转移成为家庭收入的重要组成部分，显著缓解极端贫困，并减少家庭诉诸有害应对策略的需求。调查儿童失学原因时，我们发现受益家庭更可能送孩子上学，因为现金转移同时解决了上学的机会成本和直接成本——尽管前者渠道更为重要。这些发现对设计大规模支持难民儿童的政策具有重要意义。

articles.title_en: Market timing, farmer expectations, and liquidity constraints
articles.title_cn: 市场时机、农民预期与流动性约束
articles.abstract_en: We use data on price expectations from a survey of randomly sampled smallholder farmers in Mozambique. Across all crops, farmers report selling on average within three weeks of harvest, at lower prices than expected later in the season. Liquidity constrained farmers sell their harvest 50% faster than unconstrained farmers, but they increase their storage time in response to higher expected future prices. We address causality using an instrumental variables approach exploiting abnormal rainfall from cyclones Idai and Kenneth. We develop a model on market timing and its relation to price expectations and liquidity constraints.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用来自莫桑比克随机抽样小农户调查的价格预期数据。在所有作物中，农民报告在收获后平均三周内出售，价格低于季节后期预期。流动性受限的农民比不受限的农民出售收获的速度快50%，但他们因预期未来价格更高而增加储存时间。我们利用飓风伊代和肯尼斯带来的异常降雨，采用工具变量方法处理因果关系。我们建立了一个关于市场时机及其与价格预期和流动性约束关系的模型。

articles.title_en: The agricultural wage gap within rural villages
articles.title_cn: 农村村庄内部的农业工资差距
articles.abstract_en: We use unique data on daily labor-market outcomes for Indian casual workers to study labor reallocation between agricultural and non-agricultural activities within rural areas. Controlling for both individual time-invariant attributes and time-varying shocks, we find that workers who switch sectors across years or even within a week can obtain 23% higher wages by taking non-agricultural jobs. We then estimate a discrete choice model of daily labor allocation that decomposes preferences for jobs into two types of disamenities: (i) those associated with job characteristics and (ii) those associated with location. We find that the first type of disamenity is 23% of wages for men and 38% for women, and the second type is 36% of wages for men and 31% for women.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用印度临时工每日劳动力市场结果的独特数据，研究农村地区农业与非农业活动之间的劳动力重新配置。在控制个人时不变属性和时变冲击后，我们发现跨年甚至一周内转换部门的工人从事非农业工作可获得高出23%的工资。随后，我们估计了一个每日劳动力分配的离散选择模型，将工作偏好分解为两类不利因素：（i）与工作特征相关的，（ii）与地点相关的。我们发现，第一类不利因素对男性而言相当于工资的23%，对女性为38%；第二类对男性为36%，对女性为31%。

articles.title_en: English language requirement and educational inequality: Evidence from 16 million college applicants in China
articles.title_cn: 英语语言要求与教育不平等：来自中国16万高考考生的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the unintended effect of English language requirement on educational inequality by investigating how the staggered rollout of English listening tests in China’s high-stakes National College Entrance Exam (NCEE) affected the rural–urban gap in college access. Leveraging administrative data covering the universe of NCEE participants between 1999 and 2003, we find that the introduction of English listening tests significantly lowered rural students’ exam score percentile ranks relative to their urban counterparts, resulting in a 30% increase in the rural–urban gap in college access. Our back-of-the-envelope calculations suggest that, as a result of this policy change, more than 54,000 rural students lost college seats to their urban peers between 1999 and 2003, and another 11,000 rural students who elite colleges could have admitted ended up in non-elite colleges, causing them significant future income losses.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过研究中国高风险高考中英语听力测试的分阶段引入如何影响城乡大学入学差距，探讨了英语语言要求对教育不平等的意外影响。利用覆盖1999年至2003年间所有高考参与者的行政数据，我们发现英语听力测试的引入显著降低了农村学生相对于城市同伴的考试百分位排名，导致城乡大学入学差距增加了30%。我们的粗略估算表明，由于这一政策变化，在1999年至2003年间，超过54,000名农村学生将大学名额让给了城市同龄人，另有11,000名本可被精英大学录取的农村学生最终进入了非精英大学，给他们造成了显著的未来收入损失。

articles.title_en: Thermal stress and financial distress: Extreme temperatures and firms’ loan defaults in Mexico
articles.title_cn: 热压力与财务困境：极端温度与墨西哥企业贷款违约
articles.abstract_en: The frequency and intensity of extreme temperature events are likely to increase with climate change. Using a detailed dataset containing information on the universe of loans extended by commercial banks to private firms in Mexico, we examine the relationship between extreme temperatures and credit performance. We find that unusually hot days increase delinquency rates, primarily affecting the agricultural sector, but also non-agricultural industries that rely heavily on local demand. Our results are consistent with general equilibrium effects originated in agriculture that expand to other sectors in agricultural regions. Additionally, following a temperature shock, affected firms face increased challenges in accessing credit, pay higher interest rates, and provide more collateral, indicating a tightening of credit during financial distress.
articles.abstract_cn: 随着气候变化，极端温度事件的频率和强度可能会增加。利用包含墨西哥商业银行向私营企业发放的全部贷款信息的详细数据集，我们研究了极端温度与信贷表现之间的关系。我们发现，异常炎热的天数会增加违约率，主要影响农业部门，但也影响严重依赖本地需求的非农业行业。我们的结果与源于农业并扩展到农业地区其他部门的一般均衡效应一致。此外，在温度冲击之后，受影响的企业在获取信贷方面面临更大挑战，支付更高的利率，并提供更多抵押品，这表明在财务困境期间信贷收紧。

articles.title_cn: 合同、市场准入与森林砍伐
articles.abstract_en: We study the impacts of market access on forest loss in Ghana through a program designed to increase smallholder participation in oil palm commodity markets. Improved market access is facilitated through production contracts in which smallholders receive credit to establish production, a guaranteed price and quantity for the contract duration, and output pickup at the village. Using a variety of difference-in-differences approaches, we find substantial increases in forest loss in targeted villages following the introduction of the contracting program. The findings suggest that the ecological impacts of reforms to market access may be sizeable.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过一项旨在提高小农户参与油棕商品市场的计划，研究了市场准入对加纳森林损失的影响。改善的市场准入通过生产合同得以促进，小农户在合同中获得信贷以建立生产、合同期内有保证的价格和数量，以及村庄内的产出收集。使用多种双重差分方法，我们发现引入合同计划后，目标村庄的森林损失显著增加。研究结果表明，市场准入改革对生态的影响可能相当大。

articles.title_en: Import competition, labor market regulations, and firm outsourcing
articles.title_cn: 进口竞争、劳动力市场规制与企业外包
articles.abstract_en: Using unique information on firm level domestic outsourcing of manufacturing jobs by Indian firms, we propose two channels and their interaction as determinants of the fragmentation of production: import competition and labor market regulation. We find that greater import competition from China is associated with a significant increase in domestic outsourcing of manufacturing jobs — a 10-percentage point increase in the import penetration ratio leads to a 11%–14% increase in the ratio of outsourcing expenses to the wage bill of a firm. This effect is driven by multi-product firms operating in states with pro-worker labor laws. We find a corresponding increase in the likelihood of sub-contracting among informal sector firms. Our results are consistent with a model where forward-looking firms outsource more in response to an increase in import competition, when there are future firing costs that can be avoided through such outsourcing. We thus are the first to highlight that labor market regulation and its interaction with international trade can determine the organization of production. Our findings have significant development implications that take the form of movement of manufacturing production towards the informal sector (and possible subsequent impoverishment of workers) as a consequence of a major trade shock.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用印度企业国内制造业务外包的独特企业层面信息，我们提出决定生产碎片化的两个渠道及其相互作用：进口竞争和劳动力市场规制。我们发现，来自中国的更大进口竞争与国内制造业务外包的显著增加相关——进口渗透率每增加10个百分点，外包费用与工资账单之比将增加11%至14%。这一效应由在亲工人劳动法州运营的多产品企业驱动。我们发现非正规部门企业分包的可能性相应增加。我们的结果与一个模型一致，在该模型中，有前瞻性的企业面对进口竞争加剧时，会因未来可通过此类外包避免的解雇成本而增加外包。因此，我们首次强调劳动力市场规制及其与国际贸易的相互作用可以决定生产的组织方式。我们的发现具有重大的发展意义，表现为重大贸易冲击导致制造业生产向非正规部门转移（以及工人可能随之贫困化）。

excluded_items.title_en: Attenuating measurement errors in agricultural productivity analysis by combining objective and self-reported survey data
